senses.gloss: (b. h.; denom. of רֶגֶם; cmp. b. h. רֶגֶב)to cast a stone, ball &c., to pelt.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 4:9">Succ. IV, 9</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Sukkah 3:16">Tosef. ib. III, 16</cite> <he>ורְגָמוּהוּ וכ׳</he> and all the people pelted him with their Ethrogim.

<cite ref="Sotah 37a:1">Sot. 37ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>רגמתם</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 68:28">Ps. LXVIII, 28</cite>) <he>והיו … רוֹגְמִים אותם</he> and the princes of Judah threw stones at them (stirring them up to go into the sea); Mekh. B’shall., s. 5 <he>מְרַגְּמִין וכ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:8">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> <he>שר׳ אוהבו וכ׳</he> who cast stones at the king’s friend; a. e.

senses.gloss: same; to wound with missiles, bruise. Mekh. B’shall. l. c., v. supra.—Tanḥ. K’dosh. ed. Bub. 8; Yalk. Lev. 615 כבר היו מְרַגְּמִין את וכ׳ they would have bruised my face and my whole body with them (the Ethrogim).
<cite ref="T00210">same</cite>. Tanḥ. K’dosh. 8 <he>כבר היו מַרְגִּימִין איתי את כל וכ׳</he> they would have bruised me all over my body &c., v. supra.
